reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text: This serum has a beautiful, slightly stringy texture like snail mucin, but it sinks into the skin really quickly. It leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated, soft, and comfortable. As someone with sensitive skin, I've had no issues with it!
reviews.zh: 呢款精華質地漂亮，帶少少黏稠拉絲感，似蝸牛黏液，但好快就滲透入皮膚。用完之後皮膚感覺深層保濕、柔軟舒適。作為敏感肌，我用咗完全冇問題！

reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Repeat purchase, very happy with this serum, have been using it for months now. Gentle on my skin, no bad reaction so far, moisturizing and just pleasant on the skin.
reviews.zh: 回購產品，對呢款精華非常滿意，已經用咗幾個月。對皮膚溫和，到目前為止冇任何不良反應，保濕之餘用落亦好舒服。

reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text:
I already like to toner so I wanted to try the serum as well.
It's surprisingly good actually. I add it after the toner and before another serum, or after another serum.
My skin looks healthy, and moisturized, and doesn't become sticky at all.
reviews.zh:
本來已經鍾意化妝水，所以想試下呢款精華。
結果意外地好用。我會喺化妝水之後、另一支精華之前用，或者喺另一支精華之後用。
皮膚睇落健康水潤，而且完全唔會變得黏笠。

reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text: light but also viscous? texture. i would say its thicker than most serums but lighter than snail mucin. it goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly leaving the skin looking plumb. However, I find it not as moisturizing as compared to other barrier serums I have tried
reviews.zh: 質地輕盈但又帶黏稠感？我會話佢比大部份精華杰，但比蝸牛黏液稀。搽上皮膚順滑，吸收快，令皮膚睇落飽滿。不過比起我用過嘅其他屏障修護精華，保濕度就冇咁出色。

reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text: This serum provides excellent hydration and leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and comfortable throughout the day. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly without any stickiness, and it helps strengthen the skin barrier while giving the skin a healthy glow. I enjoyed using it and will definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華保濕效果出色，用完皮膚全日都感覺柔軟光滑又舒適。質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會有黏笠感，有助強化肌膚屏障，俾到皮膚健康光澤。用得好開心，一定會回購。

reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Leaves my skin looking shiny and glossy. Doesn't feel sticky, is lightweight, and is easy to apply. No irritation and I think it does protect my skin barrier. Would purchase again.
reviews.zh: 用完皮膚望落有光澤感。唔會黏笠，質地輕盈，易於塗抹。冇刺激感，覺得真係有保護到肌膚屏障。會再次購買。

reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text: This serum is super hydrating but still lightweight, which is perfect for oily to combination skin. It gives my skin a healthy glow without making it oily or sticky. I noticed my skin barrier felt stronger and calmer after using it regularly. It layers well with other skincare products and keeps my skin soft and moisturized throughout the day. I love how smooth and fresh my skin looks after applying it.
reviews.zh: 呢支精華超級保濕但仍然輕盈，啱晒油性到混合性肌。畀皮膚一種健康嘅光澤，又唔會油笠笠或者黏笠。持續用咗之後，感覺到皮膚屏障強咗、穩定咗。同其他護膚品夾得好好，可以令皮膚成日都保持柔軟同保濕。用完之後皮膚睇落好滑好清新，我好鍾意。

reviews.shade: Anua 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum 50ml
reviews.text:
Gentle, Milky, and Barrier-Friendly – A Must for Dehydrated Skin

The ANUA 77% Rice + Ceramide Toner quickly became a staple in my routine. It has a slightly milky, lotion-like texture that feels incredibly soothing and nourishing. Unlike watery toners, this one gives an immediate plump and soft finish — like a glass of water for your face.

I use it both in the morning and at night, and it layers beautifully with other products. Thanks to the ceramides, it supports my skin barrier and helps calm down any irritation or tightness.

Perfect for dry, sensitive, or dehydrated skin — and especially great if you’re recovering from over-exfoliation or harsh weather. I’ll absolutely repurchase.
reviews.zh:
溫和、似牛奶、對屏障友善——缺水肌必備

ANUA 77% Rice + Ceramide Toner 好快就成為我日常步驟嘅必備。佢有少少似乳液嘅質地，用落感覺非常舒緩和滋養。同一般爽膚水唔同，呢支即刻畀到一種飽滿柔軟嘅妝效——好似畀塊面飲咗杯水。

我朝早同夜晚都會用，同其他產品疊加得好靚。有神經醯胺嘅關係，可以支撐皮膚屏障，幫助鎮定任何刺激或者繃緊嘅感覺。

好適合乾性、敏感或者缺水嘅皮膚——如果你過度去角質或者經歷過惡劣天氣之後，更加啱用。我一定會回購。
